title: 第1580章 合欢之物各自盘算第1579章 夫君今日好像不禁逗了
slug: 自缚禁地五百年我当散修你哭啥
content_zh:
冰清钟情丹，楚湘灵可不陌生。
因为此丹本就是合欢宗独有之物，甚至此丹的炼制方法，历来也只有宗主一人知晓。
毕竟。
合欢宗性质摆在那，总有人追求完美，楚湘灵虽然没用过这东西，可也炼制过不少。
而如今察觉到温雅使用了此丹之后，楚湘灵顿时眉头紧锁起来。
无他。
冰清种情丹的力量太强，不仅仅是让自身变得趋向完美，还能影响他人对自己情根深种，哪怕是在合欢宗这样的魔门，此物也属于禁品。
每一颗丹药从炼制出来开始，就会受到管制追踪，赠予下去之后，也得当场服用。
不得私存。
按理来说，这东西绝对不可能流出到外界，更别说流到三垣孽海了。
不过她并未选择直接追问。
只是看着还在顾修面前，一副楚楚动人，魅惑十足的温雅，眼神渐渐冷淡了起来。
“有意思……”
“是合欢宗前面的历代宗主之中的某个人来了三垣孽海，把合欢宗的传承留在这里了？”
“还是说，三垣孽海有办法，窃取我合欢宗的传承？”
冰清种情丹可不仅仅只是有丹方就能炼制的，还是要辅以特殊手段，而这手段需要合欢宗宗主一脉的独门心法才能支持。
更重要的是。
冰清种情丹无法长时间存储。
哪怕是放在储物戒指，亦或者什么特殊空间，丹药也会慢慢挥发，并在三年内彻底失效。
这就意味着，炼制温雅这枚丹药之人，大概率还活着，并且就在凛冬城内！

温雅并不知道，她已经被楚湘灵识破并盯上了。
不过哪怕知道，此刻的她，大概率也顾不上了，因为现在的她，正满是期待着顾修的反应。
这可是冰清种情丹，她曾经有幸见到过有人使用。
当初北君想要拿下墨家盘踞的聚宝城，特地培养了一个绝对忠诚的死士，服用了冰清种情丹，而目标是当时的聚宝城城主。
本来当时没人相信这丹药能有什么作用。
因为那位城主身为八阶半圣的实力，平日里花天酒地惯了，素来都是将女子视作玩物看待。
至少温雅当初没觉得有任何可能性，哪怕那名死士因为丹药的缘故变得极为漂亮。
在她看来，也最多就是能够当一段时间宠妾罢了。
却没想到。
仅仅只是第一次见面，那名花天酒地荒淫无道的城主，突然就彻底动了心，之后竟然一反常态守身如玉了起来，后来更是跟中了毒似的，为了那死士做了很多次几乎算是不经过大脑思考的决定。
这简直颠覆了温雅的认知。
若非后来墨易安插手，把那城主除了的话，聚宝城早就归属北君掌控了。
可见这丹药效果之强。
所以。
此刻的温雅也很好奇，眼前这位出类拔萃的三垣人皇，彻底迷恋上自己，又会是什么样子。
content_en:
Bingqing loves Dan, and Chu Xiangling is no stranger to it.
Because this elixir is unique to the Hehuan Sect, even the refining method of this elixir has always been known only to the sect leader.
after all.
Given the nature of the Hehuan Sect, there are always people who pursue perfection. Although Chu Xiangling has never used this thing, he has refined it a lot.
But now that he realized that Wen Ya had used this elixir, Chu Xiangling suddenly frowned.
Nothing else.
The power of the Bingqing Love Pill is so strong that it not only makes oneself perfect, but also affects others to have a deep love for oneself. Even in a magic sect like the Hehuan Sect, this thing is prohibited.
Every pill will be controlled and tracked from the moment it is refined. After it is given as a gift, it must be taken on the spot.
Not allowed to be kept privately.
Logically speaking, it is absolutely impossible for this thing to flow out to the outside world, let alone flow into the Sanyuan Niehai.
However, she did not choose to ask directly.
Just looking at the charming and charming Wen Ya who was still in front of Gu Xiu, his eyes gradually became cold.
"Interesting..."
"Did someone from the previous sect leaders of Hehuan Sect come to Sanyuan Niehai and leave the inheritance of Hehuan Sect here?"
"Or is it that Sanyuan Niehai has a way to steal the inheritance of our Hehuan Sect?"
The Bingqing Love Pill can not only be refined with the recipe, but also needs to be supplemented by special methods, and this method requires the unique mental method of the Hehuan Sect leader.
What's more.
Bingqing Zhongqingdan cannot be stored for a long time.
Even if it is placed in a storage ring or some special space, the elixir will slowly evaporate and become completely useless within three years.
This means that the person who refined Wen Ya's elixir is most likely still alive and in Winter City!
Wen Ya didn't know that she had been spotted and targeted by Chu Xiangling.
But even if she knew it, she would most likely not care about it at this moment, because she was looking forward to Gu Xiu's reaction.
This was Bingqing's Love Pill, and she had been lucky enough to see someone use it.
When Beijun wanted to take over Jubao City where the Mo family was entrenched, he specially trained an absolutely loyal dead man and took Bingqing Zhongqing Dan, and his target was the then lord of Jubao City.
At first, no one believed that this elixir could have any effect.
Because the city lord was an eighth-level semi-saint, he was used to living and drinking, and he always treated women as playthings.
At least Wen Ya didn't think there was any possibility at first, even if the dead soldier became extremely beautiful because of the elixir.
In her opinion, the most she could do was to be a concubine for a while.
But I didn't expect it.
It was just the first time they met, and the city lord who lived a life of drunkenness and debauchery suddenly became completely attracted to him. After that, he became uncharacteristically guarded. Later, it was as if he was poisoned. He made many decisions for the dead man that were almost without thinking.
This simply subverted Wen Ya's cognition.
If Mo Yi'an hadn't intervened later and eliminated the city lord, Jubao City would have been under Beijun's control long ago.
This shows how powerful this elixir is.
so.
At this moment, Wen Ya was also very curious about what it would be like for the outstanding Sanyuan Renhuang in front of her to be completely obsessed with herself.
